verdict.rationale: The evidence shows versioned CLI package releases (@yylo/cli@0.2.2, a 0.2.1rc6 channel) and independently versioned Skills, but nothing describes a versioned API surface or any deprecation or compatibility policy. Probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404, and the Ledger docs say it serves local views 'without exposing a mutation API'. Package version numbers alone do not meet the story's requirement of versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy.
